title: Epic Wine and Waterfall Tour
blurb:
Start an unforgettable adventure with us as we explore the stunning Niagara Falls and the charming town of Niagara on the Lake. 

We’ll take you on a scenic drive through picturesque landscapes to Niagara-on-the-Lake, with plenty of stops for photo opportunities that are sure to become your new favourite lock screen!

Along the way, we’ll visit three renowned local wineries, where you’ll indulge in tastings of exquisite wines and enjoy some leisurely shopping. And—all tastings are included!

While you're enjoying the sights, tastes, and experiences, our expert local guide will share fascinating stories about Niagara Falls, the history of Canada, the War of 1812, the power of hydroelectricity, and so much more!

Get ready for a day filled with breathtaking views, delicious wines, and captivating history!
